analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad featuring a curly-haired model using the pink Turblow Pro with diffuser, advertising a 25% off Spring Break Sale.
analysis.full_description: A square studio promotional image for WavyTalk Turblow Pro. At the top, bold dark typography reads 'SPRING BREAK SALE' and 'TURBLOW PRO' with the subheading 'Faster Drying, Less Damage'. A light purple circular badge on the upper left announces '25% OFF'. In the center, a woman with defined, voluminous dark curls smiles towards the camera while holding the pale pink Turblow Pro hair dryer fitted with a diffuser bowl to the underside of her curls. Diagonal ribbons across the bottom read 'BEAUTY IN FULL BLOOM' and 'SPRING BREAK SALE'.

on_screen_text.text: BEAUTY IN FULL BLOOM • SPRING BREAK SALE • BEAUTY IN FULL BLOOM
